item.title: Savannah Guthrie says her family is offering a $1 million reward for her mother’s recovery
item.description: "Today" show host Savannah Guthrie said her family is now offering a $1 million reward for information leading to the recovery of her mother.

item.title: Utah County Attorney’s Office will continue prosecuting Tyler Robinson, judge rules
item.description: A 4th District judge denied a motion Tuesday to disqualify the Utah County Attorney's Office from prosecuting the Tyler Robinson capital murder case.

item.title: Utah religious leader targeted in Sandy shooting speaks out
item.description: A person fired several shots at a religious leader in Sandy on Monday night while he was in his car. He wasn't hurt, and police were still searching for the shooter on Tuesday.

item.title: State of the Union offers Trump a chance to make the case for his foreign policy approach
item.description: The State of the Union offers President Donald Trump a chance to make the case for his foreign policy efforts to Americans who are increasingly demonstrating uneasiness about his priorities.

item.title: Louvre Museum director resigns in the wake of October’s brazen French crown jewels heist
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron has accepted the resignation of the Louvre Museum’s president.

item.title: Sundance Film Festival sets dates, theaters for first Colorado edition in 2027
item.description: The Sundance Film Festival has set its 2027 festival dates and key venues as it shifts to Boulder, Colorado.

item.title: Utah lawmakers take first step towards taking elections responsibilities from the lieutenant governor
item.description: A committee of Utah lawmakers gave the first thumbs up to a proposal to strip the lieutenant governor of the responsibility to oversee Utah's elections.

item.title: Lack of snow allows UDOT to use budget for road repairs
item.description: There is a silver lining to the dark cloud that is Utah's current lack of snow — extra time and funds to go to repairing Utah's roads.

item.title: Utah lawmaker wants to criminalize encouraging suicide in sextortion schemes
item.description: Rep. Ryan Wilcox, R-Ogden, wants to add penalties to the crime of sextortion where scammers urge victims to die by suicide.

item.title: Cartel violence fuels doubts about FIFA World Cup games in Mexico
item.description: The violence that followed the killing of a cartel leader in Mexico is fueling fears that the bloodshed could hurt tourism ahead of the FIFA World Cup later this year.
